lines.zh: 我一摇一摆地走，像片乌云
lines.en: I waddle along like a scrap of storm cloud.
My claws pick-pick at the ground.

lines.zh: 我走得急，脖子一伸一缩
lines.en: I hurry, neck pumping in and out.
My feathers are dark as coming rain.

lines.zh: 我绕过水洼，不想弄湿脚
lines.en: I skirt the puddles; wet feet are no good.
I break into a run, wings half spread.

lines.zh: 草地上留下细细的爪印
lines.en: Thin claw marks trail behind me.
I peck for bugs as I go.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我的羽毛全鼓起来
lines.en: Wind puffs out every one of my feathers.
I head toward the barn.
I stop and tip my head at the ground.
Three steps, one peck.

lines.zh: 我的影子在地上一颠一颠
lines.en: My shadow bobs along the ground.
I walk by the fence, hunting shade.

lines.zh: 土很松，我一爪子就翻开
lines.en: The soil's loose; one scratch turns it over.
I quicken my pace; the weather's turning.
I squat, feathers fluffed.
I look up; the clouds are thick.
Weather like this suits me best.
I shake myself as if shedding raindrops.

lines.zh: 我咕咕叫了两声，风更大了。
lines.en: I clucked twice, and the wind picked up.

lines.zh: 一只眼睛闭上，一只还睁着
lines.en: One eye shuts; the other stays open.
I stand on one leg, quite steady.
The wind bends my tail feathers.
I peck at the feathers on my breast.

lines.zh: 地上有块石子，我盯了很久
lines.en: There's a pebble; I stare at it a long while.

lines.zh: 我往前挪了挪，找了个干处
lines.en: I shuffle forward to a dry spot.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里发出低低的声音
lines.en: A low sound rumbles in my throat.

lines.zh: 雷声很远，我一点也不怕
lines.en: Thunder, far off. It doesn't scare me.

lines.zh: 我理了理翅膀下的羽毛
lines.en: I tidy the feathers under my wing.
I tilt my head as if listening.
Just staying like this is fine.
Have you got grain in your hand?

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，脖子伸得很长
lines.en: I stretch my neck to look up at you.
You smell of rain.
People don't scare me — being grabbed does.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我就靠近一点
lines.en: You crouch, and I come a little closer.

lines.zh: 我歪头，左眼看看，右眼看看
lines.en: I tilt my head and look with each eye.

lines.zh: 你一靠近，我就拍翅膀往后跳。
lines.en: When you come close, I flap back and hop away.
Don't reach too fast; I startle easily.
Your shadow has covered me.

lines.zh: 我咕了一声，算是打了招呼
lines.en: I cluck once — a sort of greeting.
Catching me? I'm quick.

lines.zh: 看够了没有，我要去啄食了
lines.en: Done looking? I've got foraging to do.
I screech and thrash.

lines.zh: 灰白羽毛落了一地，我跳开。
lines.en: Gray feathers scatter as I hop away.
I hop away on a bad leg.
I curl up small.
It wasn't heavy, but it frightened me.

lines.zh: 我叫得整个院子都听见
lines.en: My outcry fills the whole yard.
My wing's bent; I can't fly.

lines.zh: 雷雨里，我的羽毛全炸开。
lines.en: In a storm, all my feathers stand up.
I hide behind the haystack.
Stop — I can't run anymore.
Grain! I see it.
Scatter a handful and I'll come.

lines.zh: 我啄一下，抬头看你一眼
lines.en: I peck once, then look up at you.
I like that smell.
Don't clutch it; open your hand.

lines.zh: 我跑起来，翅膀都张开了
lines.en: I run over, wings spread.
A few grains left on the ground — let me look.
I peck fast, afraid of being robbed.
Step back and then I'll dare to eat.
That handful's not enough. More?
I cluck as I eat.
Crumbs are easier to peck than whole grains.
I won't snatch; I'll wait for you to scatter.

lines.zh: 你手心的温度我感觉得到
lines.en: I can feel the warmth of your palm.
When these are gone, I'll wander off.
Scatter it a bit farther; I can't reach.
The bump knocks me sideways.
Your feet are huge; I can't dodge.
I slip between your legs.
I flap twice and get my feet under me.
A feather fell out. No harm.
Sorry — I wasn't watching.
Too narrow here for the two of us.
I hop back a step.
A bump, and I cluck loudly.
My feathers carry static.
You've dark feathers too.

lines.zh: 我张着翅膀，绕着你转圈。
lines.en: Wings spread, I circle around you.
We peck together, neither snatching.
I call, and you answer.
Behind this haystack we'd be out of the wind.
You squat down and I lean in.
On rainy days we shelter together.

lines.zh: 我不走远，就在这片院子
lines.en: I won't go far — just this yard.
Slow down; I can't keep up.
It's late; we should find a place.
One grain, two — I peck them all.
I pick it up and drop it again.
So small I can barely see it.
I flick it aside.
Ground things — I try them first.
I peck it. It's a stone.
This mouthful has sand in it.

lines.zh: 我把它扒拉到草里藏起来
lines.en: I scratch it into the grass to hide it.
You dropped it? Mine now.

lines.zh: 嘴里这点，够我嚼一会儿
lines.en: This bit will keep me busy a while.
Something's moving in the grass.
My neck shoots straight up.
That's no bug. Too big.
I stare, afraid to blink.
A shadow sweeps over the ground.
I back up against the fence.

lines.zh: 发出声音的是风，不是它
lines.en: That was the wind, not it.
I look again to be sure.
It isn't coming my way.
I cluck low, a warning.
I edge toward it, bit by bit.

lines.zh: 雷云底下，我和它比谁先动。
lines.en: Under the storm cloud, we wait to see who moves first.
I tilt my head for another angle.
I can feel the ground shake.
Wings half open, ready to run.
It's close to the haystack.
I go around, the other way.
I stop and pretend to peck.
It turned; I pull my neck in.
I'll move once it's gone.
I lunge and peck once.
My wings beat across — just once.
I leap, claws first.

lines.zh: 这已经是我最大的力气
lines.en: That's all the strength I have.
Peck, then run.
My clucking is fiercer than my pecking.
I drove it away from the feed.
Every feather stands on end.
It retreated; I don't chase.
Come again and I'll go for the eyes.
Thunder was rolling when I broke the shell.
I shake off the bits of shell.

lines.zh: 这身羽毛，从一开始就深
lines.en: These feathers were dark from the start.

lines.zh: 我第一眼看到的是湿草
lines.en: The first thing I saw was wet grass.
I try to stand; my legs shake.

lines.zh: 云压得很低，我从草垛里钻出来。
lines.en: Clouds hang low; I crawl out of the haystack.
I cluck; the sound is thin.
The hen is nearby; I head for her.

lines.zh: 我扑了扑翅膀，还飞不起来
lines.en: I flap; I can't fly yet.

lines.zh: 这个世界比壳里亮太多
lines.en: This world is far brighter than the shell.
My feathers curl up at once.

lines.zh: 从高处落下，我砸在地上
lines.en: I fall from a height and hit the ground.
I thrash, and water fills my throat.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀起来，羽毛全焦了。
lines.en: The blast flips me over, my feathers scorched.

lines.zh: 一根细东西扎进我翅膀
lines.en: Something thin pierces my wing.
I can't move, as if held down.
No grain to find; my legs weaken.

lines.zh: 雷就在旁边炸开，我耳朵嗡响
lines.en: Lightning cracks nearby; my ears ring.

lines.zh: 我脚下一空，一直往下落
lines.en: The ground gives way and I keep falling.
